sources.title: droplychee 1.0 27b — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A multimodal model built on Qwen3.6's 27B architecture, droplychee 1.0 handles both text and image inputs, producing text outputs. As an open-weight release under MIT license, it can be run and modified freely. Specific capability details beyond its multimodal architecture are limited from available information.

sources.title: droplychee-1.0-27b — VRAM, Quants & GPU Compatibility
sources.snippet: droplychee-1.0-27b by droplychee-core — 27.78B parameter mit model with 262K context. Minimum 18GB VRAM (Q4_K_M quantization). Compatible with 48 GPUs, cloud rental from $0.16/hr. 3 quantization options available.
